name: Good Times: Retro Game Emulator
summary:
Step into a cozy room inspired by the 1980s and 1990s, choose your console and play on a CRT TV.

• Five systems: Super Nintendo, Mega Drive, Master System, NES and Atari 2600.
• Import compatible games you are authorized to use or explore the built-in catalog.
• Customize cartridge names and covers. Start a game and its cartridge appears in the console.
• Keep your collection and progress on the headset, ready to resume later.
• Play with Touch controllers or a compatible gamepad; use hand tracking for men
